original_test_intent: Verify all expected TEMP2 sensors for HIB VR1 through VRN are correctly mapped to their distinct VR components and physical locations and report human-readable temperature, status and thresholds matching the approved VR thermal specification.
original_method: Define TEMP2 sensing placement and intended relationship to TEMP1, enumerate every expected HIB VR channel and immutable raw/UI identity, collect complete temperature/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized TEMP1, nearby thermal, fan/PWM and VR power context, and compare each result to the owner specification.
manual_activity: The owner defines TEMP2 placement, HIB VR topology, limits and any permitted TEMP1 comparison; an operator verifies raw/UI/context correlation and the owner adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/firmware and HIB VR1..N hardware inventory
TEMP2 physical sensing location and HIB VR-to-SDR/Redfish/UI mapping
Approved TEMP1-versus-TEMP2 relationship plus read-only nearby temperature, fan/PWM and VR power context
UI refresh/rounding/sensor-lag tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep the check read-only and passive; never change VR voltage/load, fan, threshold or thermal policy
Use protected authentication and complete non-truncated enumeration
Bind each TEMP2 reading to its physical HIB VR and synchronized context
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on overtemperature, VR fault, alarm, impossible/stale value, unexpected sensor-pair behavior or mapping/cooling issue
Do not force TEMP1/TEMP2 convergence by changing load or airflow

Assist with synchronized TEMP1/TEMP2 and WebUI capture under owner comparison rules
Report missing, extra, stale, alarm, placement, pair-relation or raw/UI/context/spec mismatches for owner verdict
Perform no VR/thermal stimulus or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Supply authoritative TEMP2 placement, HIB VR mapping, limits and TEMP1 relation
Review sensor-pair, VR power/thermal, raw/UI and context discrepancies

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-VR matrix containing HIB/VR and TEMP2 physical location, raw temperature/unit/status/threshold, approved TEMP1 relation, nearby thermal/fan/power context and UI display, with population and specification results.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact TEMP2 placement and explicit sensor-pair semantics while replacing insecure/truncated reads, log clearing and active stimulation.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Two nearby VR sensors can legitimately differ due to placement, calibration and response time; equality or ordering is invalid unless defined by the project thermal map.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently target TEMP2 HIB VR temperatures and thresholds. Physical placement and TEMP1 relationship are necessary project inputs rather than contradictory source instructions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: TEMP2 placement, VR mapping, thermal specification and complete raw/UI/context evidence gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Separates TEMP2 from TEMP1 at identity, limits and evidence levels and prevents an assumed equality from becoming a false criterion.
independent_technical_reasoning: TEMP2 naming establishes a second channel, not a duplicate measurement. Sensor placement, thermal path and sampling can make it consistently warmer, cooler or slower than TEMP1, so an unapproved equality rule would create false failures. Correct validation requires independent immutable identities and limits, plus synchronized pair/context evidence interpreted through the owner map. Passive observation preserves the original sensor-page scope and avoids inducing thermal risk.
